title: Electronics products that have never been ordered
prompt: How many products in the electronics category have never appeared in a single order?
metricDefinition: count of electronics products with zero order_items.
transformationPlan: find which products appear in order_items
count electronics products absent from that set
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id)

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'electronics'
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Forgets to filter to unmatched rows (oi.order_item_id IS NULL) — without that, this just counts every electronics product, ordered or not.
